title: Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for heigh

translated_title: 世界模型能预测水稻生长吗？迈向农业世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型可以想象物理场景在未来几秒内如何演变，但种植者需要知道作物在未来数周乃至数月内将如何发育：这株水稻一个月后会抽穗吗？收获时它又会是什么样子？我们提出“农业世界建模”这一任务，即根据一张植物照片、其品种信息以及相机视角，预测同一株植物在所需的数天至数月时间跨度后将呈现的外观。在初步分析中，即使是最先进的图像生成器也会出错：它们往往让植物生长不足，或赋予其错误生长阶段的颜色和形态。我们认为，这是因为它们没有推算出植物的发育状态，而照片只能间接揭示这一状态。因此，我们提出AgroWM，它在绘制生长之前先对发育进行推理。其推理模块PhenoClock计算出当前的生长阶段，预测未来的生长阶段，并编写一份包含株高等数值目标的Growth Script（生长脚本）。
tldr: 本文提出农业世界建模任务及AgroWM框架，其PhenoClock推理模块先推算水稻当前的发育阶段并预测未来阶段，再据此生成植株在数天至数月后的外观，克服了现有图像生成模型无法准确预测作物长期生长的局限。
en_tdlr: We introduce agricultural world modeling and propose AgroWM, whose PhenoClock reasoning module infers the rice plant's current developmental stage and predicts the future one before generating its appearance over days to months, overcoming the inability of state-of-the-art image generators to accurately predict long-term crop growth.
